lines.zh: 我在走廊里来回走，脚步不快。
lines.en: I pace the corridor, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我的关节响，但我走得很稳。
lines.en: My joints creak, yet my walk is steady.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边张望两边。
lines.en: I walk while glancing both ways.
I reach the doorway and turn back.

lines.zh: 我的围兜晃了一下，我扶住了。
lines.en: My bib swings; I steady it.
I walk along the seams of the tiles.
I lift a foot and set it down slowly.

lines.zh: 我走过舞台，灯光打在身上。
lines.en: I cross the stage; a light finds me.
I drag a foot; the floor answers.

lines.zh: 我停下来，把头转了个方向。
lines.en: I stop and turn my head.
I keep a hand on the wall as I walk.
I step around the toys on the floor.

lines.zh: 我站在舞台边，眼睛看观众席。
lines.en: I stand at the stage edge, eyeing the seats.
My beak opens and shuts gently.

lines.zh: 我抬手整理了一下围兜。
lines.en: I smooth my bib.

lines.zh: 我的手指在身侧动了一下。
lines.en: My fingers move once at my side.
I tilt my head as if hearing music.

lines.zh: 灯照着我，我的外壳有点旧。
lines.en: The lamps find me; my shell is a little worn.

lines.zh: 我不动，但眼睛一直在转。
lines.en: I stand still, but my eyes keep moving.
I am waiting for opening time.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己脚边的地砖。
lines.en: I look down at the tiles by my feet.
I turn my head toward you, slowly.
You have come at a bad time.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，像在打招呼。
lines.en: I call out, as if greeting you.
You step back; I stay where I am.
I tilt my head, beak parting slightly.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，我没有假装。
lines.en: When you look at me, I do not pretend.
I raise a hand, then let it fall.

lines.zh: 你不该在这个时间进来。
lines.en: You should not have come in at this hour.

lines.zh: 我把头转到另一边，又转回来。
lines.en: I turn my head away, then back.

lines.zh: 我挡住了通向后台的路。
lines.en: I am blocking the way backstage.
I step back; a joint pops.

lines.zh: 我低头看被打破的地方。
lines.en: I look at the broken place.

lines.zh: 我发出一点电流的杂音。
lines.en: A little current-noise escapes me.
I press a hand over the split.
I do not cry out. I only stand.

lines.zh: 灰尘从我的关节掉下来。
lines.en: Dust falls from my joints.
I set my head straight and keep watching.

lines.zh: 外壳凹了一块，披萨还热着。
lines.en: My shell is dented, but the pizza is still warm.
I recognize what you are holding.
I take one step toward you. Slowly.
I reach for it, without force.
I take it and look it over.

lines.zh: 我的喙嚼着，什么也没掉。
lines.en: My beak works; nothing falls out.

lines.zh: 我把它放进围兜的口袋。
lines.en: I drop it into the pocket of my bib.
This pleases me a little.
I accept it and step back to my post.
If there is nothing else, go.

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，我退了半步。
lines.en: You hit me; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我的外壳硬，你的肩先疼。
lines.en: My shell is hard; your shoulder hurts first.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚，我抽了回来。
lines.en: You step on my foot; I pull it free.
My bib brushes you.

lines.zh: 黏糊糊的围兜蹭过你的袖子。
lines.en: My greasy bib drags across your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我被你撞得歪了，慢慢站正。
lines.en: Knocked crooked, I slowly straighten.
As you back away, you hit the door.
I am not angry.

lines.zh: 另一个玩偶在后台等我。
lines.en: Another animatronic waits for me backstage.
We stand side by side, turned to each other.

lines.zh: 她的头靠过来，靠得很轻。
lines.en: Her head leans in, very gently.
We walk toward the stage together.
She hands me a wire.
We put our hands together.

lines.zh: 她的声音和我的一样坏。
lines.en: Her voice is as broken as mine.
We wait for the lights together.
She takes the left. I take the right.
Before the show, we do not speak.
I bend and pick it up.
I look at it and put it in my bib.
I hold it between my fingers.

lines.zh: 我的手有点僵，掉了两次。
lines.en: My hand is stiff; I drop it twice.
I hold it up to the light.
I set it on the stage edge.

lines.zh: 我闻不到味道，但我知道这是什么。
lines.en: I cannot smell it, but I know what it is.
I push it into a seam in my chest.
I take it out again and set it down.
I drop it and walk away.
You struck me. Only then do I move.

lines.zh: 我停下张望，转头对准你。
lines.en: I stop scanning and fix on you.
My beak opens wider than before.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，这回是真的。
lines.en: I cry out. This time it is real.
I come at you without going around.

lines.zh: 你退到墙边，我还在往前。
lines.en: You back to the wall; I keep coming.

lines.zh: 我端着托盘，慢慢转向你。
lines.en: Holding my tray, I turn slowly toward you.
My fingers spread.
I am not fast, but I will not stop.
You have dirtied my bib.
The lights on this floor start to flicker.
I take my first step toward you.
I am at the door. You cannot leave.

lines.zh: 我不再装成普通的玩偶。
lines.en: I stop pretending to be an ordinary animatronic.
My head has straightened.
I follow, neither fast nor slow.

lines.zh: 你到哪一间，我就到哪一间。
lines.en: Whatever room you enter, I enter.
I push the door open.

lines.zh: 你的手电照过来，我挡了一下。
lines.en: Your torch finds me; I raise a hand.
I do not shout. It wastes power.

lines.zh: 我在走廊尽头站着，等你过来。
lines.en: I stand at the end of the hall, waiting.

lines.zh: 你退到角落，那里没有门。
lines.en: You back into a corner. No door there.
I push a chair out of the way.

lines.zh: 我每次拐弯都比你早一步。
lines.en: I take each corner a step before you.
I count the doors you shut.
My steps have not stopped.
There is power for a while yet.

lines.zh: 你把灯关了，我没有慢下来。
lines.en: You kill the lights; I do not slow.
I am getting closer.

lines.zh: 这里每一扇门我都开过。
lines.en: I have opened every door here.

lines.zh: 你回头看的时候，我在走廊中间。
lines.en: When you look back, I am mid-hall.
I have shut the back door.
I hear you breathing.

lines.zh: 你站的那块地砖，我踩过。
lines.en: I have stepped on that tile before.
I swing a hand and knock you down.
My beak bites into your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣服，往前拖。
lines.en: I grab your clothes and drag you forward.
I ram you with my body. Heavy.

lines.zh: 这一下打偏了，撞到墙上。
lines.en: The blow goes wide into the wall.
I shove you away, stiffly.

lines.zh: 我的手指按进你的手臂。
lines.en: My fingers press into your arm.

lines.zh: 你滚开了，我踩碎了地砖。
lines.en: You roll clear; I crack a tile.
You land a hit; I do not step back.
I lower my head, beak toward your face.
I pin you at the stage edge.
You are shoved through the door.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，脚步声就是提醒。
lines.en: I lift a foot; the step is the warning.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，往下拉。
lines.en: I seize your wrist and pull it down.

lines.zh: 我用整只手臂把你扫开。
lines.en: I sweep you away with a whole arm.
You are down, and I am still walking.
That one puts you back three steps.
My beak snaps shut by your ear.

lines.zh: 托盘砸下来，番茄酱溅开了。
lines.en: The tray comes down and ketchup splatters.

lines.zh: 你砍我一下，我还是往前走。
lines.en: You cut me once. I keep coming.
The stage lights come up; I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我从后台走出来，脚步很轻。
lines.en: I come out from backstage, softly.

lines.zh: 我把围兜拉正，开始巡视。
lines.en: I straighten my bib and begin my round.
My voice box pops once.

lines.zh: 我走到台前，看了看观众席。
lines.en: I step to the front and look at the seats.
I am minding this floor tonight.

lines.zh: 我的外壳上有一道新的划痕。
lines.en: There is a fresh scratch on my shell.

lines.zh: 我先在走廊里走了一圈。
lines.en: I take one lap of the corridor first.
The lights are not all up. I wait.

lines.zh: 披萨的油味先我一步进了走廊。
lines.en: The smell of pizza grease reaches the hall before I do.

lines.zh: 我从储物间出来，把门关上。
lines.en: I come out of the closet and shut the door.
I settle and listen for anyone.

lines.zh: 外壳被烤软，味道很难闻。
lines.en: My shell softens; the smell is foul.

lines.zh: 我从舞台边掉下去，零件散了。
lines.en: I fall off the stage edge; parts scatter.

lines.zh: 水进了电路，我动得很慢。
lines.en: Water reaches my circuits; I move slowly.

lines.zh: 爆炸把门和我一起掀翻。
lines.en: The blast throws the door and me over.
An arrow jams in one of my seams.
That light heats my circuits.

lines.zh: 电快没了，我的动作更僵。
lines.en: Power is nearly gone; I grow stiffer.
Lightning gets in; a fuse burns out.

lines.zh: 黑暗里没有地板，我往下落。
lines.en: No floor in the dark; I fall.
